decisions.reason: The track spotlight has had its own page for two consecutive years, which signals sustained commitment, and keeping a catalog item in a lighting portfolio costs little.
The ceiling luminaire has had a stable dedicated presence since 2023, so the option shows no sign of failing and is cheap to maintain.
Launched only in 2024, its prospects are still uncertain, and a spotlight variant is a low-cost option worth keeping open while market results come in.
The multi-outlet canopy is a recent accessory-type product with low holding costs, so it is too early to judge its value and abandon it.
The low-voltage canopy is a niche variant whose value is still unresolved, and it complements product D at little extra cost.
It is only mentioned rather than given a page of its own, which suggests weaker commitment, but one year is too little evidence to abandon a cheap option.
